context:
Single-line move from core deps to dep-groups. Verify with the existing
`validate_todo.py` workflow which is the sole consumer.
description:
`jsonschema>=4.25.1` is declared on line 42 of `pyproject.toml` as a CORE
runtime dep, but the only import site in the entire repo is
`_project/scripts/validate_todo.py:18` - internal TODO management
tooling that is **not** packaged into the wheel.

Two reasonable resolutions:
  A. Move `jsonschema` to `[dependency-groups] dev` (or a dedicated
     `dev-tooling` group) so contributors who run TODO tooling still
     get it but end users don't.
  B. Move it into a tooling-scoped `_project/scripts/pyproject.toml`
     so internal tooling has its own dependency surface.

Option A is the smaller change and the recommended path here. Option B
is a larger refactor and out of scope.

Source for this finding: `docs/development/dependency-inventory.md` (F2),
produced by `audit-imported-dependencies-for-elimination`.

deferrals.reason: Larger refactor; out of scope for this small cleanup.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] superseded: extract-project-scripts-to-isolated-env (DONE) already extracted _project/scripts/ to its own pinned env/manifest, satisfying this ask.

preserves.behavior: Fast test suite green after the change
